headline: JEEZY EXTENDS VEGAS RESIDENCY THROUGH NEW YEAR'S EVE
body: @jeezy added nine final dates to his Legend of the Snowman Las Vegas residency, running November 6 through New Year's Eve at PH Live. At the August 22 show, Clark County Commissioner William McCurdy II presented him with the Key to the Las Vegas Strip as LeBron James joined the moment. The official schedule lists the new November and December performances.
caption:
@jeezy added nine final dates to his Legend of the Snowman Las Vegas residency, running November 6 through New Year's Eve at PH Live. At the August 22 show, Clark County Commissioner William McCurdy II presented him with the Key to the Las Vegas Strip as LeBron James joined the moment. The official schedule lists the new November and December performances.
